# Sequencing and Hybrid-Assembly Validation Contract

## Simulation Truth

- Reference genome, requested coverage, read length/insert distribution or long-read
  error profile, read type, seed, assembler settings, and truth structural variants.

## Required Results

- FASTQ/FASTA read files, read manifest/QC summary, assembly FASTA, assembler logs,
  QUAST report/summary, and parameter manifest.

## Required Figures

- Read-length and coverage distributions.
- Assembly contiguity/accuracy trade-off across design settings.
- QUAST genome fraction, misassembly, and N50 comparison against known reference truth.

## Pass Criteria

- Read files are non-empty and sample identifiers/read pairs are consistent.
- Observed coverage and length distributions are compared with requested settings.
- Assembly metrics are taken from parsed QUAST output against the exact simulated or
  declared reference; N50 alone is never a pass criterion.
